entries.2549fdc40bea7445: A placement service providing free job-search support specialized for fourth-year university students. Its strengths are supporting students who continue job hunting after the peak of job offers and students who started late, and it runs interview preparation training and group interview events.
entries.2854aef36ffad146: A job site that uses a diagnostic engine to match the profiles companies want to hire with university students' aptitudes and introduce job openings.
entries.28dcf6949370324d: A business supporting university students' job hunting.
entries.28e30cdda75cb642: Pre- and post-employment retention support training
entries.422085c810236cf4: It provides training such as the '7 Habits®' training, the 'Harada Method®' training, 'Dale Carnegie' training, the 'Discovery' training for new employees and 'Basics of Work' training, through in-house format, in which instructors are dispatched to companies, and through open seminar format.
entries.644cb8c21f0be737: A business supporting university students' job hunting. It offers three recruitment channels: placement services, joint company information sessions and a job site. Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥1,770 million.
entries.674c17ce4b399451: For the people it places, the company provides training programs ranging from pre-employment training that eases anxiety before joining to a program over the first year after joining that teaches reporting, communication and consultation (hōrensō) and workplace relationships, supporting retention and performance.
entries.75434e4cbd4c575f: Held by consolidated subsidiary Campus Support Co., Ltd., which is entrusted by the University Co-op Business Federation with supporting university students' job hunting and career development, this is a joint company information session.
entries.8dac41c2205ef46f: A business centered on training for companies. In addition to package training and training programs by level, it sells aptitude diagnostics and operates a career interview platform. Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥1,118 million.
entries.903b543ec0025d49: A service that combines free job-search support courses for the employment potential group, covering self-analysis, interview preparation and the mindset expected of working adults, with job placement.
entries.929a81ceaf1ec12a: A job site that uses a diagnostic engine to match the profiles companies want to hire with university students' aptitudes and introduce job openings. It also offers direct recruiting features.
entries.9a113d53f9087b8b: A service that combines free job-search support courses for the employment potential group, covering self-analysis, interview preparation and the mindset expected of working adults, with job placement. Courses include ones for women only, for dropouts only, and limited to people in their 30s. It also provides interview venues where job seekers and companies meet at group interview events.

entries.d0767a64efdda254: A career interview platform business operated by consolidated subsidiary Kakedas Co., Ltd. It also sells aptitude diagnostics in this area.
